relationships.subject: BTX-A
relationships.evidence_quote: BTX-A inhibited SPP1 mRNA and protein expression in LPS-treated microglia

relationships.subject: SPP1
relationships.evidence_quote: indicating that SPP1 targeted by BTX-A contributes to pyroptosis of LPS-induced microglia

relationships.subject: BTX-A
relationships.evidence_quote: SPP1 depletion or BTX-A treatment reduced the levels of GSDMD-N, NLPRP3, and ASC and suppressed the production of inflammatory factors

relationships.subject: LPS
relationships.evidence_quote: the mRNA expression of TNF-α, IL-6, and IL-1β was upregulated in LPS-treated microglia

key_findings: SPP1 is induced in LPS-treated microglia and in SNI; BTX-A or SPP1 knockdown reduced NLRP3, ASC, GSDMD-N and TNF-alpha/IL-6/IL-1β.
BTX-A and SPP1 knockdown improved withdrawal thresholds in SNI rats.
